name: fastapi-react-tasks
title: Orbit Tasks - FastAPI API + React SPA monorepo (two services)
description: A team task board split into two deployable services: a FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + SQLite JSON API using the OAuth2 password flow (form-urlencoded /auth/token, Bearer JWT), and a React 19 + Vite + React Router 7 SPA served by nginx that proxies /api/ to the API container.
dev: cd api && uvicorn app.main:app --port 8015 --reload  # and in another shell: cd web && npm run dev

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.description: HS256 secret for the API's access tokens (compose passes it to the api service).

env.name: CORS_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed by the API. Not needed when the SPA talks to the API through the nginx /api proxy (same origin).

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: SQLAlchemy URL for the api service; compose sets sqlite:////app/data/orbit.db on the named volume.

env.name: AUTO_SEED
env.description: Seed demo users/projects/tasks at API startup when the users table is empty.

env.name: VITE_API_URL
env.description: Docker build ARG for the web image (baked into the bundle). Defaults to /api in compose so the SPA uses the nginx proxy; set http://localhost:8015 for a local Vite dev server.

auth.description: OAuth2 password flow: POST application/x-www-form-urlencoded username+password to /auth/token (via the SPA at /api/auth/token) -> {access_token, token_type: bearer, expires_in}. The SPA keeps the token in memory + localStorage and sends Authorization: Bearer on every call; /admin/* requires role=admin (403 otherwise, enforced server-side and mirrored by a client-side 403 page). Deactivated users are rejected with 403.

persistence: SQLite file inside the api container at /app/data/orbit.db on the named volume orbit-api-data (created and seeded automatically at API startup). The web service is stateless static files.
notes: services: api (FastAPI/uvicorn, container port 8015, published 8015, healthcheck /healthz) and web (nginx:1.27-alpine serving the built SPA, container port 5015, published 5015, depends_on api healthy). The web container's nginx.conf proxies /api/ -> http://api:8015/ (prefix stripped) and provides history-API fallback to index.html, so only port 5015 needs to be exposed publicly; 8015 is optional for direct API access/Swagger. VITE_API_URL is a BUILD-TIME arg for the web image - rebuild the web image to change it. Local (non-Docker) run needs two processes: uvicorn on 8015 and Vite on 5015 with VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8015 and CORS_ORIGINS including http://localhost:5015.
